about: One entry per release that needs more than a redeploy. `coderhelm-selfhost upgrade` prints every entry between the installed and the target version, and stops at an entry with breaking: true until it is run again with --yes (after doing what the entry says). Releases with no entry are plain redeploys: tables and buckets keep their data, items only gain fields.

releases.notes: First self-host release: one config file, the single-origin web stack, Bedrock as a model provider.
